Name: (CP) Seasonal Sam's Kids for Unique Children and Unique Children Talk
Author: allaviyu
Description:
[quote]﻿﻿SUBMODS/ASSETS FOR THE MOD/S '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]UNIQUE CHILDREN[/url]﻿' AND/OR '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9540]UNIQUE CHILDREN TALK[/url]﻿﻿' BY [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/693835]SHAKLIN[/url]﻿[/quote]

[size=3][color=#f9cb9c]Note:[/color][color=#f6b26b] [/color][u]These are just assets to be placed within respective folders it is required to be placed in. The portraits and sprites will work unless [color=#fff2cc]Content Patcher[/color] or the [color=#fff2cc]Unique Children Mods[/color] isn't updated to the current versions or you have installed incorrectly.[/u][/size]


[quote]!! THIS IS A [b]COMMISSION PIECE[/b] THAT WAS CONSENTED BY THE COMMISISONER TO BE SHARED !![/quote] 
[size=3]HOW TO INSTALL MY ASSETS IN REQUIRED MODS:[/size]

FOR [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]UNIQUE CHILDREN[/url] SPRITES:
[list=1]
[*]SIMPLY EXTRACT THE [CP] FILE IN YOUR [u]"Mods"[/u] FOLDER AND HAS [u]"UniqueChildren"[/u] INSTALLED.
[/list]
FOR ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9540]UNIQUE CHILDREN TALK[/url]﻿ PORTRAITS NAMED [PORTRAITS]:
[list]
[*]UniqueChildren Talk > assets > [u]Portraits[/u]
[/list]
[list=1]
[*]FIND THE [u]"Unique Children Talk"[/u] FOLDER IN YOUR MODS.[img]https://i.ibb.co/Sm9KnqP/step-1.jpg[/img]﻿
[*]GO TO [u]"assets"[/u] AND PASTE AND EXTRACT THE CHOSEN [u]"Portraits.zip"[/u] FILE INSIDE THE FOLDER.[img]https://i.ibb.co/YPsXFZP/step-2.jpg[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/mTmRND6/step-3-uct.jpg[/img]﻿﻿

[/list][i]
[/i]For the [u][color=#f9cb9c]Portraits[/color][/u], you [u]need[/u] to change the place holder names to your children's names. You have to do it for every single image file to work.

ex. BoyName_Spring > Name_Spring

Please do note that you've renamed them in whatever sentence case you used in naming your children in-game. (example, sammy would be sammy_Spring/SAMANTHA would be SAMANTHA_Spring)


[color=#f9cb9c]Hello!
[/color]
After seeing the personal assets I made and shared for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21032?tab=description]Elliott[/url]﻿, I was contacted to do a piece for Sam. As stated before, this is a[color=#f9cb9c] commissioned piece [/color]that is, with consent from the person who commissioned me, now shared to the public! I have modeled the design of the kids after [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12115]Sam Revised Hair Portrait - Seasonal[/url] because the commissioner had told me they like using it for Sam's appearance. We hope that everyone who uses this love it!




If you're interested in commissioning your own sprites and portraits, please don't hesitate to ask me here on nexus or on my [url=https://bsky.app/profile/mx-yang.bsky.social]bsky[/url] acc! If I'm free from my academics, I'll be able﻿ help you with it!
